title: HtmlData
responsibility: Renders the native data element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlData.attributes
inputs.description: Native data attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlData.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native data element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlData
outputs.description: The actual native data element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
